description: PDF corpus for the PDF JavaScript accuracy study (docs/pdf-js-accuracy-preregistration.md). dev: Apache PDFBox test resources (plus CD03 from evaluation/c2pa_corpus.json); held-out: Apache Tika and Mozilla pdf.js test PDFs. A file whose SHA-256 equals an earlier entry's is marked duplicate_of and evaluated once, under the earlier entry (dev before held-out).

licences.apache/tika: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE; test documents of mixed origin, e.g. govdocs1)
licences.mozilla/pdf.js: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE; test PDFs of mixed origin)
